script.problem: A quote isn't the BSB's exact words.

terra.problem: Calling light the first thing on the list overlooks the heavens and the earth, which God created in verse 1.
The explanation says God told both the sea creatures and the birds to fill the waters. He told the sea creatures to fill the waters and the birds to multiply on the earth.
The joke imagines a blessing saying “don't move” in the context of God's blessing. Jokes must not put invented words in God's mouth.
“Nothing gets left out” goes beyond the things God names as being under man's rule.
